title: YURI SDS-Plus Concrete Drill Bit, 6mm Tip Diameter, 160mm Total Length, for AEG, Bosch, Hilti, Metabo
description: The YURI 6mm SDS-Plus Concrete Drill Bit by GT Global Traders is a reliable and robust tool designed for precision drilling in concrete, masonry, and stone surfaces. With a total length of 160mm and a working length of 100mm, this drill bit offers excellent reach and control for a wide range of drilling tasks. The 6mm tip diameter ensures clean, accurate holes every time. Featuring an SDS-Plus shank, this drill bit is compatible with leading power tool brands including AEG, Bosch, Hilti, and Metabo, making it a versatile addition to any toolkit. Manufactured to ISO 9001 quality standards, the YURI drill bit is built to deliver consistent performance and long-lasting durability. The spiral flute design efficiently removes debris from the hole as you drill, reducing heat build-up and improving overall drilling efficiency. Whether you are a professional tradesperson or a dedicated DIY enthusiast, this drill bit is an essential tool for your next construction or renovation project.
